name: A177 re-issue of A136's queue_a163_h10.json: A163 h10.00 RETRY.  The nine queue_a163 nodes whose chosen (largest-margin) citeable set was chain_BOTH_base_r0.20_h1.25_nof0_+00.00 and whose in_sets ALSO contain chain_BOTH_base_r0.20_h10.00_nof0_+00.00.  Three of the nine (Y0054, Y0183, Y0380) were run on h1.25 and returned all four NO children ALIVE with the LP converging to eta = 0 at tau = 5 -- the h1.25 cover proves nothing on this frame -- while the FIRST NO child run on h10.00 (Y0941 NO0, 2026-09-09 10:14) certified DEAD.  Largest margin over s0 is therefore the wrong entry choice on this frame; this queue forces the h10.00 leaf.  Y0054 and Y0380 carry ALIVE docs/shadows pages.  Run with --out_suffix _a163h10: the node records and the NO-child certificates are keyed by node id, so the h1.25 records must not be reused.  Y1110 is prepended: it is the third ALIVE-page node on this leaf and it had not been started when queue_a163_gallery's worker ran out of usable wall, so it has no _a163 record to preserve and belongs with the rest of the h10 lane.  Y1110 is DROPPED here -- its NO0 came back genuinely LP-ALIVE on this leaf (eta = 0 at tau = 5, converged), so the node cannot close on it.
